description: This file defines the TransferHistoryRepository class, which manages transfer history data within the app. It provides methods to observe all transfer records, filter by connection ID, log new transfer start events, mark transfers as complete, and delete transfer records.

classes.name: TransferHistoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing transfer history of file uploads and downloads, providing functions for observing, adding, updating, and deleting transfer records.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Observable Flow of all transfer history entities.

methods.name: historyForConnection
methods.description: Returns a Flow of transfer history entities filtered by a specific connection ID.

methods.name: logTransferStart
methods.description: Logs a new transfer start event with status 'IN_PROGRESS', recording details such as connection ID, file paths, direction, and timestamp.

methods.name: markTransferComplete
methods.description: Marks an existing transfer as complete with success or failure, updates status, completion time, bytes transferred, and error message.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a transfer record based on its ID.
